pkgmetadata.longdescription: FigCraft is an interface design and prototyping tool: frames with auto layout, components with variants and overrides, vector networks, styles and variables with modes, and prototypes with interactions and a presentation view. Documents are .figcraft archives; it exports PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG and PDF, and opens .fig files on a best-effort basis. It ships a headless figcraft-cli for rendering, export, scripted commands and an MCP server. This is the upstream prebuilt x86_64 release; it renders through Vulkan, or OpenGL/EGL where Vulkan is missing.
